chunks: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abī Najrān, from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from one whom he mentioned, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام gave judgment concerning a slave who had divorced his wife with two divorces and then had intercourse with her afterward. So he ordered a man to strike them both and separate them, flogging each one of them with fifty lashes.

key_terms.مَمْلُوكٍ: a slave or owned male person
key_terms.يُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا: he separates the two of them

ai.seo_question: What was the ruling of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام on a slave who had intercourse with his wife after divorcing her twice?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام regarding a slave who resumed marital relations after issuing two divorces to his wife. It establishes separation between the two and a corporal punishment of fifty lashes for each, reflecting the jurisprudential treatment of unlawful intercourse in this case.
